'''icebreath An Entire Legion Of My Worst Troops v2.0 - Classic''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[David Kangas|icebreath]]
* '''Published:''' 18 March 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS3]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time|ECC-D-thisdealisgettingworseallthetime.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS3 Deal icebreath DS 2003 AnEntire.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

TDIGWATT Troopers.  I've taken some of your guys' advice, as well as fixed a few things I say during some fun games over the last week or two.

The published list has 61 cards.

== Strategy ==

Just so we don't have a repeat of last time, I'll spell it out right here: THIS IS AN IMP-ONLY DECK.  Imperial Domination (V) doesn't work with CC Troopers.  It doesn't work with Bounty Hunter ships.  It doesn't work with Probe Droid (V)s.  It only works with Imperials and Imperial starships.  If one person - just ONE person - tells me to put in something other than Imperials or Imperial starships, I'll have their butt in a sling.  Understood?  Good!  >:)

Here's a turn-by-turn of what to do until you get Dark Deal going:

Turn 1.  Pull your two sites using I'm Sorry, activate, pull Cloud City using your objective, play the sites and the sector, draw up.

Turn 2.  Activate, pull Bespin using the objective, draw up.

Turn 3.  Activate, pull Dark Deal using the objective, play a bunch of troopers to your sites and a TIE or two to the sector, and play Dark Deal.

After that, just keep on draining.  You should have 2 of the Elite Squadron Stormtroopers (each with an Assault Rifle) at your center site (along with a Stormy Cadet and maybe another trooper or two), Tarkin with a Stormy Cadet and Vader at another site, and Tagge with a Stormy Cadet and a couple other troopers at the third site.  That should only be 10-15 of your 25 guys.  You've got 5 guys who're going in space, leaving your last 5 to annoy your opponent with.  With Trooper Assaults galore, you shouldn't have to ever lose any troopers on the ground.

As for space, Jonus keeps you from forfeiting anyone you don't want to... you can toss him to soak up all of the attrition and battle damage.  All you have to do is innitiate another battle elsewhere, and retrieve him again with Imperial Domination (V).  Praji can then pull him from your deck, and you can re-deploy him aboard his ship for another round of fighting.

I'm not going to post specific card choices right now... if you're wondering about a certain card, LMK in the discussion area, and I'll put it here.  Also, LMK if you've got any questions about matchups or how the deck is played.

David Kangas

Shadow 31
